title: MultiverseCreatures
description: Plugin for custom themed creatures and items on Spigot/Paper

---

# MultiverseCreatures

MultiverseCreatures is a themed creatures and items plugin for Paper 1.21.11+ that brings custom entities, unique items, and multiverse-inspired mechanics to your Minecraft server.

---

## Entities

| Creature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Mahoraga** | An adaptive zombie that evaluates your full inventory on every tick. Sharpness grants it Resistance (up to IV), Knockback grants knockback immunity, Protection grants Strength, distance grants Speed. It evolves mid-combat. |
| **Dio Brando** | A full boss with a Stand companion, time-freeze attack (THE WORLD), teleportation, and custom player head texture. Configurable health, damage, cooldowns, and drop rates. |
| **HeadSlime** | A slime that attaches to players, applying Blindness and Slowness while draining health over time. Only Head Slime Gelatin can remove it instantly. |
| **Creeper Jr.** | A creeper that spawns 3 copies at once. Explosions chain-react and push nearby non-player entities away while clearing other Creeper Jr. targets. |
| **ZombieHorseTrap** | A zombie horse that triggers an entire army on death: a heavy-armored **Tank**, a bow-wielding **Duelist**, a mounted **Lancer** on a zombie horse, a **Camel** with a Bogged Skeleton rider, and a **Wither Skeleton Sniper** with long-range arrows. |
| **Shaggy** | A wandering trader replacement with themed trades from across the multiverse. |

## Items

| Item | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Excalibur** | Netherite Sword | Solar Flare projectile — fires a sun bolt that chases enemies, dealing fire damage and knockback |
| **Ice Crown** | Hand Item | Three ice abilities: ice projectile (Slowness/Weakness), blizzard storm (AoE freeze), ice walk. Passive 20% damage reduction + freeze immunity |
| **Wirts Lantern** | Lantern | Repels hostile mobs (12-block radius), grants Night Vision (overwrite=false, 5s grace), protects targeted entities |
| **Scooby Cookie** | Food | Resistance VI for 10 seconds on consume |
| **Dio's Stand Head** | Special | Summons a Stand that follows and attacks for you |
| **Head Slime Gelatin** | Consumable | 10s complete immunity to HeadSlime with WITCH particles |
| **Head Slime Heart** | Material | Dropped by HeadSlime, used to craft Gelatin |
| **Star Core** | Material | Mysterious crafting component |
| **Military Mine** | Utility | Camouflaged explosive — copies the most common surrounding block, explodes on step, break, or interact |
| **Military Component** | Material | Crafting component for Military Mines |

## Mechanics

- **Adaptive AI** — Mahoraga evaluates your full inventory, not just your held item
- **Zombie Army** — ZombieHorseTrap spawns 5 specialized units on death
- **MSC protection** — Plugin creatures cannot damage each other
- **Configurable spawning** — Every creature has its own spawn chance in config.yml

## Commands

```
/msc spawn <type>     — Spawn a creature (mahoraga, dio, headslime, creeperjr, zombietrap, ...)
/msc give <item>      — Get an item (excalibur, icecrown, wirtslantern, diostand, militarymine, ...)
```

## Configuration

All spawn chances, boss stats, item cooldowns, death messages, and effect amplifiers are fully configurable via `config.yml`.

---

**Requires:** Paper 1.21.11+ | **Java:** 21+

*Add a touch of the multiverse to your server — adaptive bosses, legendary weapons, and hidden dangers await.*
